title: Partner webhook acknowledgements arrive late
summary: Webhook notifications remain pending beyond their normal delivery window.
precursor: After a partner maintenance window, acknowledgement latency climbed for a subset of webhook destinations while dispatch volume stayed near its daily baseline.
impact: Downstream systems receive order and account-status updates late, leaving customer-facing integrations temporarily out of sync.

title: Email digest partition stops making progress
summary: A narrow group of email jobs is repeatedly revisited while one partition's oldest-message age keeps increasing.
precursor: A digest template revision was rolled out shortly before workers began cycling through the same small set of scheduled messages.
impact: Recipients on the affected partition miss scheduled digests, and unrelated messages assigned behind those jobs are delayed.

title: Mobile push dispatches are rejected by provider
summary: Push submissions for one mobile platform are rejected, and device alerts are arriving late or not at all.
precursor: The platform credential was rotated during a scheduled identity maintenance, after which rejection rates rose sharply for newly submitted pushes.
impact: Time-sensitive account and security alerts do not reach affected mobile users within the expected delivery interval.

title: Campaign replay produces intermittent persistence failures
summary: Campaign replay requests fail intermittently and the number of newly scheduled notifications falls below the expected total.
precursor: A worker acknowledgement timeout caused the latest campaign segment to be replayed after part of the segment had already completed.
impact: Some recipients are not scheduled for delivery, and campaign completion reporting remains behind until the replay is reconciled.

title: SMS delivery slows during a verification surge
summary: SMS notifications queue up and delivery receipts arrive late during a period of elevated verification traffic.
precursor: An account-recovery surge overlapped with routine campaign fan-out, and outbound request volume rose above its recent peak.
impact: Some verification codes arrive after their validity window, increasing sign-in retries and support contacts.
